question: Around EUR 250 million from the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) were committed to Rhineland-Palatinate in the 2021-2027 programming period. Support focused on priorities such as innovation, energy efficiency in municipal buildings and measures to support small and medium-sized enterprises1. Public information on specific project content, impact assessments, evaluation results or sustainability assessments is only available in some cases. 1.
How exactly were ERDF funds used in the priority areas of innovation/competitiveness and energy efficiency? What structural cost-benefit assessment is the Commission aware of?
What specific, verifiable overall project reports demonstrate the impact of supported measures on employment, energy saving and regional added value?

What clear selection criteria does the Commission provide to prevent ERDF funds from being used for matters falling within the exclusive remit of the Länder or local authorities where there is no EU added value?
Source: https://what-europe-does-forme.europarl.europa.eu/en/region/16:1562?kind=prj&search=dorfflitzer (accessed on: 14.10.2026). 1
